games.name: Endless Nightmare
games.description: First-person horror hide & seek: hide in a dark high school while The Hollow Man hunts you down. 1-8 players.
games.notes:
Open the game and type your name on the main menu.
Host: click HOST A GAME, then COPY ROOM CODE and send it to your friends.
Friends: paste the code into the box under JOIN BY CODE and click JOIN (it can take a few seconds to connect).
In the lobby, use the arrows under your feet to pick your character. The host picks the map, the game mode (Hide and seek or Infected) and who is It, sets the rules in GAME SETTINGS, then clicks START.
Everyone needs the same version and an internet connection. No browser needed: it runs in its own window.
If Windows says it protected your PC, click More info, then Run anyway.
games.changelog:
The Hollow Man has a new walk: hunched under a hump, head locked on you, claws raised, and a long low sprint on Shift.
Eyeless sight: as It the world is black and white and hiders in view glow red (they fade if they stand still).
Dead Angle: he's slower while a hider looks at him, faster when nobody does.
During the hiding countdown It prowls the grounds outside.
New school furniture (desks, blackboards, cafeteria, gym hoops, vending machines), graffiti, taller ceilings, wider doors, grass outside.
MISSING posters board in the lobby. Flashlight is now right-click; Esc lists all the keys.
Wetter, smoother kill. Rebuilt characters (Marcus has shorts now). Download is much smaller.
